perks.name: Terminal Velocity
perks.description: Final blows with primary ammo weapons grant your primary ammo weapons temporarily increased reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
+20 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons for 6 seconds.
Buff can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.

perks.name: Power Loader
perks.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants Special ammo progress.
perks.exact:
Upon picking up an Orb of Power:
+6% Special Ammo Progress.

archetype.name: Gunner
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who take a weapon-centric approach.

Primary Stat: Weapons
Secondary Stat: Grenade

item.name: +Class / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Kinetic Scavenger
item.description: Kinetic weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
